axes.model_access: The model family is disclosed via official release notes and routed by tier (2026 line: release records for Claude Fable 5.1 / Mythos 5.1 / Opus 5 / Sonnet 5 / Haiku 5.5 etc.); models are selectable in chat, and Enterprise admins can control which models members may use.
axes.runtime: Web, desktop (macOS/Windows), mobile apps; chat generation is processed on Anthropic's cloud. The Cowork line has a local-session form (runs on your computer) alongside cloud sessions — this dossier's main axis is the chat app.
axes.local_files: Can upload documents for long-document analysis; uploaded content is stored in the Claude account. Deleted chats disappear from the front end immediately and are deleted from the back end within 30 days (official privacy policy).
axes.background: Cowork remote sessions (beta) officially state "Work continues when you close your laptop, and scheduled tasks run with no device online" (release notes 2026-07-07) — offline continuation and scheduled tasks have an official source.
axes.tools: Connector ecosystem (Microsoft 365 incl. write tools, Salesforce plugin and other official entries); Artifacts produce code and content; Skills/plugin security scanning (Enterprise beta).
axes.context: Memory is a categorized-entry system: Settings > Memory shows all Topics with per-entry edit or delete; sensitive topics are kept out of memory by default; on by default for Free/Pro/Max, off by default for Team/Enterprise (release notes 2026-08-25).
axes.permissions: Official privacy policy (effective 2026-09-10): consumer chats may be used for training by default; you can opt out in account settings; even after opting out, chats flagged by safety review are still used; API/Enterprise data is governed by customer agreements and this policy does not apply.
axes.fit: For people who value long-document reading and writing quality. For "chats never used for training", opt out in settings (note the safety-review exception); for contract-grade data terms go API/Enterprise. It is two product lines with Claude Code — don't conflate them.

runs: This site has not completed measured runs. The coding-oriented test protocol is at [protocols/coding/_protocol.md](../../../protocols/coding/_protocol.md) (the coding task suite does not apply to chat products).
